reasons.A: Long, clause-laden sentences, soft literary diction and an explicit closing moral are far from the passage's clipped, plain, unreflective declaratives.
reasons.B: Gets the short declarative rhythm and occasional fragment, but piles fragments on much more thickly than the passage and ends on a sloganish triad, reading as caricature.
reasons.C: Mostly complete short declaratives with a sparing fragment, plain practical stance, 'So'/'And' connective openings and a flat factual close, closest to the passage's movement and tone.
